jobs.description: ROS 2 and applied AI for robots — object detection and natural spoken interaction with people.
highlights: Own the ROS 2 platform behind Manara, an in-production service robot deployed at the Two Holy Mosques — autonomous navigation, motor control, and a self-docking/charging system rewritten from scratch.
Develop and maintain ROS 2 software running on deployed robots.
Build and integrate applied-AI capabilities on the robots, including object recognition and voice-based interaction with people.
Joined the team before graduating and have stayed on full-time since.
